strings: #0*There are undercover revolutionaries walking among the Redcoats.
#0*Take down all the enemies and your allies will help you get through the door.
#0*Using Eagle Vision will show your allies in blue. If you take down an ally or are detected, Connor is done for.
#01Indeed. I'll pretend to be your prisoner.
Guards, open the door! We've got the assassin!
Sir Haytham will be glad to hear that! He's waiting for you.
Well done, soldiers! You should never have trusted me, Connor...
#25The man will join your guild later.
